row.body: A house key is wrapped in a threatening note; the envelope has a return mark but no delivery mark.
row.title: The threat with a key

sidecar.gloss: A threatening message was prepared with a key but lacks proof it reached its recipient.
sidecar.rival_reading: A private dispute could explain both objects without any official action; the missing delivery mark does not identify the sender.

row.body: matching white stripes cross the hole punch and clipboard. a name-sized patch on the hole punch has been scrubbed bare.
row.title: missing count beside the hole punch

sidecar.gloss: A response bundle preserves a missing count, changed route, or erased identity.
sidecar.rival_reading: A farm-program crew could have counted routes, repacked tools, or removed ownership marks during hurried field work; the objects do not prove a concealed public response.
